title: Grouped Fourier sum at the all-one point
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$, real $\rho$, and sequence $(T_i)_{i\in\mathbb N}$ of subsets of $[2m]$ such that $|T_i|=i$ whenever $i\le 2m$, the noise operator applied to the indicator of the middle layer of $\{−1,1\}^{2m}$, evaluated at the all-one point, equals $\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{2m}\binom{2m}{i}\widehat f(T_i)\rho^i$, where $\widehat f(T_i)$ is the Fourier coefficient of that indicator at $T_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sequence of subsets of $[2m]$
